description: Wait for a duration, text, snapshot ref, selector to appear, selector to be strictly absent, or stable UI. Text matches a label, identifier, or value; an editable field never matches by its current value or by a label that only repeats it, so text you typed does not satisfy it. The strict absence target requires zero selector matches; stable waits until the UI stays quiet for the requested window. Use it to verify an expected result, such as text that appears after a network call, instead of polling with snapshot. Times out after 90s; a caller-supplied budget extends it.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.
